# CalculateMyTax

> Free UK tax calculators and plain-English guides for landlords, built on current HMRC rates.

Every figure comes from published GOV.UK, HMRC and gov.scot rates, last verified 13 September 2026. Tax years covered: 2025/26, 2026/27, 2027/28 (future year, some figures assumed). Results are estimates, not tax advice.

## Calculators

- [Rental income tax calculator](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/rental-income-tax-calculator/): Free UK rental income tax calculator for landlords and buy-to-let. Work out tax on rental income for 2026/27 with Section 24 relief, expenses and Scotland.
  - Estimates UK income tax on rental profit for every tax year in the rates file
  - Covers England, Wales and Northern Ireland, and Scotland
  - Applies the Section 24 mortgage interest credit with all three limits and carry-forward
  - Compares allowable expenses, the property allowance and Rent a Room relief, and recommends the cheapest
  - Handles joint ownership at any split, using each owner's other income
  - Pools several properties into one property business
  - Uses brought-forward property losses and unrelieved finance costs
  - Flags Making Tax Digital thresholds and the April 2027 property income rates
  - Runs in the browser with no sign-up; results can be shared as a link or printed
- [Rental yield calculator](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/rental-yield-calculator/): Free UK rental yield calculator. Work out gross and net yield, monthly cash flow and return on cash for a buy-to-let, including mortgage costs and income tax.
  - Works out gross and net rental yield from the price, rent, running costs and empty weeks
  - Itemises running costs, with the letting agent fee as a percentage of the rent collected
  - Models the first year of an interest-only or repayment mortgage, with interest cover
  - Shows monthly and annual cash flow and the return on the cash you put in, including buying costs
  - Estimates income tax on the rental profit with Section 24, for England, Wales, Northern Ireland and Scotland
  - Runs in the browser with no sign-up; results can be shared as a link or printed
- [Stamp duty calculator](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/stamp-duty-calculator/): Free UK stamp duty calculator for England, Scotland and Wales. Work out SDLT, LBTT or LTT on a second home, a buy-to-let or your first home, band by band.
  - Covers Stamp Duty Land Tax, Land and Buildings Transaction Tax and Land Transaction Tax
  - Handles an extra property, your only home, and first-time buyer relief where it exists
  - Adds Scotland's Additional Dwelling Supplement and Wales's separate higher rates
  - Shows every band, the rate on each slice and the rate the whole price really bears
  - Compares what the same purchase would cost on another basis
  - Runs in the browser with no sign-up; results can be shared as a link or printed
- [Buy-to-let investment calculator](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/buy-to-let-investment-calculator/): Free UK buy-to-let investment calculator: stamp duty, the cash you need to buy, a rent-cover check, and monthly cash flow after income tax.
  - Works out stamp duty, LBTT with the Additional Dwelling Supplement, or LTT, band by band
  - Adds up the cash needed to buy, including the deposit, fees and refurbishment
  - Runs a lender-style rent-cover check at your own stress rate, cover and loan limit
  - Shows the rent needed to break even, before income tax
  - Estimates first-year cash flow after running costs, the mortgage and income tax
  - Illustrates cash flow, equity and sale proceeds year by year over the period you choose
  - Compares two options side by side, and runs in the browser with no sign-up

## Guides

- [Tax on rental income](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/tax-on-rental-income/): Tax on rental income explained: you pay income tax on rental profit at the rate your income reaches. See HMRC's five steps, worked examples and 2026/27 rates.
- [Allowable expenses for landlords](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/allowable-expenses-for-landlords/): See which costs UK landlords can deduct from rent, from repairs and agent fees to insurance, plus the rules on improvements, replacements and mortgage interest.
- [Section 24 mortgage interest relief](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/section-24-mortgage-interest-relief/): Section 24 swaps the mortgage interest deduction for a 20% tax credit. See who it affects, the three limits, carry-forward and worked examples for landlords.
- [Property allowance or expenses](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/property-allowance-vs-expenses/): The £1,000 property allowance lets landlords deduct a flat amount instead of expenses. See when it saves tax, what you give up and two worked examples.
- [The Rent a Room Scheme](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/rent-a-room-scheme/): The Rent a Room Scheme lets you earn £7,500 a year tax free from a furnished room in your home. See who qualifies, how methods A and B work, and the deadlines.
- [Rental income tax in Scotland](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/rental-income-tax-scotland/): Rental income tax in Scotland is charged at Scottish rates if your main home is there. See the 2026/27 bands and how Section 24 relief works for you.
- [Property income tax rates from April 2027](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/property-income-tax-rates-2027/): From 6 April 2027, rental profit in England and Northern Ireland is taxed at 22%, 42% and 47%. See who is affected, what changes and worked examples.
- [Making Tax Digital for landlords](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/making-tax-digital-for-landlords/): Landlords with qualifying income over £30,000 must use Making Tax Digital from 6 April 2027. See the thresholds, quarterly deadlines and exemptions.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/faq/): Yes, you pay income tax on rental profit. Plain answers for UK landlords on tax rates, allowances, mortgage interest, tax returns and deadlines.

## Who we can help and services

- [Who we can help](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/who-we-can-help/): Tax help for landlords with a first let, a lodger, a shared property, a mortgage, a home in Scotland or Making Tax Digital ahead. Find the guide for you.
- [First-time filers](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/who-we-can-help/first-time-filers/): Your first landlord tax return explained: when to tell HMRC, registering by 5 October, records to keep, Section 24 and payments on account.
- [Our services](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/our-services/): Landlord tax services from CalculateMyTax. We can prepare and file your Self Assessment tax return, including the UK property pages. Contact us for a quote.
- [Self Assessment tax returns](https://muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/our-services/self-assessment-tax-returns/): We prepare and file landlord Self Assessment tax returns, covering the UK property pages, allowable expenses and the Section 24 credit. Ask for a quote.
